layout.body_en:
My dad used to say that a tree with strong roots can weather any storm.
I didn't understand that when I was young. I understood it the moment I started cooking in a tiny kitchen, trying to make food that actually made me feel good.
That kitchen became Roots.
No investors. No business plan. Just a frustration, a stove, and a belief that real food shouldn't be complicated.
This is where it started — and why it still matters.
layout.body_cn:
我父亲常说，

根扎得深，树才能经得住风雨。
年轻的时候，我没太在意这句话。
直到后来，我在一个小小的厨房里开始做饭——只是想吃到让自己真正舒服、真正好吃的东西。就在那时，我才真正懂了他的意思。
那个厨房，就是 Roots 的起点。
没有投资人，没有商业计划，什么都没有。有的只是一股不服气，一个灶台，还有一个简单的想法：好的食物，不应该这么复杂。
这是我们的来处，也是我们一直在做的事。

# Privacy Policy

## What Information We Collect

We collect information to help you use our app better:

- Account Information: Your name, phone number, and delivery address when you create an account
- Order Information: What you buy, when you buy it, and how you pay
- Device Information: Your phone type and app version (to fix bugs and improve the app)
- Location: Your location (only when you allow it) to help with delivery

## How We Use Your Information

We use this information only to:

- Deliver your orders correctly
- Show you better product recommendations
- Fix problems in the app
- Keep your account safe
- Send you updates about your orders
- Respond to your questions

We never sell your information to others.

## Who Can See Your Information

Only our team members who need it to:
- Process your order
- Arrange delivery
- Handle customer service

These team members must keep your information private.

## How We Keep Your Information Safe

- We use password protection for your account
- We encrypt your payment information (don't send it directly)
- Only authorized staff can access your data
- We regularly check our security systems

## How Long We Keep Your Information

- **Order information**: 3 years (for tax and support reasons)
- **Account information**: Until you delete your account
- **Location data**: Only during active delivery

## Your Privacy Rights

You can:

- View what information we have about you
- Change your name, phone, or address anytime in settings
- Delete your account and all your data (just contact us)
- Stop location sharing in your phone settings
- Ask us questions about your privacy anytime

## About Cookies and Tracking

The app may use simple tracking to:
- Remember you're logged in
- Track how you use features (to make them better)
- Show you relevant offers

You can turn off most tracking in your phone settings.

## When We Share Your Information

We only share your information when:

- Delivery Partner: Your address and phone (so they can deliver your order)
- Payment Company: Your payment info goes to payment processors (WeChat Pay, Alipay)
- Legal Requirement: If the government asks us (very rare)

We will never share your information with advertisers or companies for marketing.

## How We Handle Children's Privacy

If you're under 18, tell a parent or guardian. We don't collect extra information from children. The privacy rules are the same for everyone.

## Updates to This Privacy Policy

We may update this policy sometimes. We'll notify you of big changes through the app or email.

## Contact Us

Questions about privacy?

- Company: Roots Lab (哈素萌)
- Phone: +86 191 2885 2597


---

**Last Updated**: June 2026

content.founder_quote_en:
My dad used to say,

"If the roots of a tree are strong, it will weather any storm."
I never thought much about it when I was younger.
Years later, when I started building this company from a tiny kitchen, I found myself thinking about those words often.

Roots didn't start with investors, a business plan, or ambitions of building a brand. It started with a simple frustration: I wanted food that made me feel good and tasted good too.
So I started cooking.

What began as experiments in a small kitchen turned into recipes. Recipes turned into products. Products turned into conversations, customers, and eventually a community.

There were plenty of moments when giving up would have been easier. Limited resources, long nights, mistakes, setbacks—we faced our share of storms.
But my father's lesson stayed with me.

Focus on the roots.

Build a strong foundation. Use real ingredients. Make food you're proud to serve. Stay honest. Stay consistent.
Everything else grows from there.
That's where our name comes from.

Not plants. Not trends. Not marketing.
Roots.

Because if the foundation is strong enough, growth takes care of itself.

Today, we're still guided by the same principle that started it all: create food that nourishes people, brings them together, and leaves things a little better than we found them.

This is Roots.
content.founder_quote_cn:
父亲常说：树深根固，方能不惧风雨。年少时，我从未把这句话放在心上。多年后，我从一间小小的厨房起步创办这家公司，才屡屡想起这番话。

这份事业的根基，并非始于投资人、商业计划书，或是打造品牌的宏图壮志。一切的开端，只是一个简单的心愿：我想吃到既美味又能让人身心舒畅的食物。于是我开始下厨尝试。
从小小厨房里一次次摸索，慢慢沉淀出专属配方；配方化作一件件产品；产品又联结起人与人的交流，迎来一位位顾客，最终凝聚成一个温暖的社群。


前行路上，无数个瞬间，放弃本是更轻松的选择。资金有限、彻夜忙碌、失误碰壁、坎坷挫折，我们历经了一场又一场风雨。但父亲的教诲始终铭记于心：深耕根基，筑牢底色；选用真材实料，用心做出引以为傲的食物；坚守本心，持之以恒。其余的一切，自然会顺势生长。


这便是我们品牌名字的由来——根基（Roots）。无关花草绿植，无关潮流风向，更不靠营销造势。只因根基稳固，成长自会水到渠成。


时至今日，我们依旧坚守最初的初心：用心制作滋养身心的食物，以美食联结彼此，努力让一切变得更加美好。 

这里，就是「根基」。
